sample_parsed_object.answer: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a model architecture that combines retrieval-based methods with generative models to enhance the quality of generated text. It retrieves relevant documents or information from a large corpus and uses this information to inform and improve the generation of responses, making the output more accurate and contextually relevant. RAG typically involves two main components: a retriever that fetches pertinent documents and a generator that produces text based on the retrieved information.
